sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:32

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:32:1
items.html: Also her Malchut spread, and her nine Sefirot spread in the discernment of back to back, below the Chazeh. And one must be exact, for above (in this part, item 13) he wrote that as long as they do not use one Keter, and the Nukva needs to receive from ZA, her Malchut is found included in her Yesod, and there is in her only nine Sefirot, lacking Malchut. However, the intention here is not to an expansion of her Malchut literally, but to the discernment of the expansion of her Atara of Yesod, in the secret of the bottom of the bowels; and this was through Moses.
